adjudication.rationale: In `packages/app-store/googlecalendar/lib/CalendarService.ts`, both `updateEvent` and `deleteEvent` now compute the calendar id as `externalCalendarId ? externalCalendarId : event.destinationCalendar?.find((cal) => cal.externalId === externalCalendarId)?.externalId`. When `externalCalendarId` is falsy (the else branch), the `.find(... === externalCalendarId)` compares against `undefined`/`null`, so it will not match a real `externalId` and returns `undefined`. This makes the destination-calendar resolution effectively dead/wrong in that branch and can cause updates/deletes to fall back to an unintended calendar (or pass an undefined calendarId depending on later defaults). This defect is directly introduced by the diff.
